propositions: When a ticket re-enters review with a BLOCK verdict and unchanged description component fingerprint, a deterministic pre-check must compare cited evidence anchors from blocking findings against the current plan text.
If all matched anchors remain verbatim in the plan, emit a warn-only message naming the persisting findings and their criteria before running the review, but never decline or exit with error.

Anchors that cannot be matched verbatim (paraphrased evidence or structural findings with no quote) are treated as unmatchable and do not trigger the warning on their own; the warning fires only if at least one anchor matched AND all matched anchors are untouched.
The warning must be recorded in sidecar metrics as precheck.cited_anchor_warning (true or false on every review) to enable offline measurement of hit rate and predictive value per ADR 0054.
